scalar:
set -euo pipefail
shells=()
while IFS= read -r candidate; do
  shells+=("$candidate")
done < <(find "$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH" -type f \
  \( -name headless_shell -o -name chrome-headless-shell \) -print)
if [ "${#shells[@]}" -ne 1 ]; then
  printf 'expected one Playwright headless shell, found %s\n' "${#shells[@]}" >&2
  if [ "${#shells[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${shells[@]}" >&2
  fi
  exit 1
fi
test -x "${shells[0]}"
case "${shells[0]}" in
  "$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH"/chromium_headless_shell-1228/*) ;;
  *)
    printf 'headless shell is not Playwright revision 1228\n' >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
printf '%s\n' "${shells[0]}" > "$OTIO_BROWSER_PROOF_DIR/headless-shell-path.txt"
printf 'RELIC_OTIO_CHROME_PATH=%s\n' "${shells[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
policy: Actual workflow run scalar; fixture binaries are never executed; independent cache/proof/environment per case. No vendor or browser writes.
